items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That was when Mutt was with you... Mutt was with me, yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] He used to play Papa Mutt's heart.

ctx.x: That was when Mutt was with you, because he used to play Papa Mutt's heart. Mutt was with me, yeah.
He used to play Papa Mutt's heart.
But when Oliver was with him, he wasn't sitting in then. No.
